EffectMetric.description: Metric for which you want to detect the smallest relative difference.

ErrorCorrectionType.description: Multiple-testing correction method applied when evaluating metric significance.

MetricsFilter.description:
Boolean filter applied to the A/B test population. Each filter targets a boolean metric
and decides whether to include (true) or exclude (false) matching records.

trackEffects.description: Whether the experiment should record the effects of this filter.

includes.description: If true, keep items that match the filter; if false, exclude them.

MetricsFilters.description: List of metric filters applied to the test population.

MinimumDetectableEffect.description: Configuration for the smallest difference between test variants you want to detect.

size.description:
Smallest difference in an observable metric between variants.
For example, to detect a 10% difference between variants, set this value to 0.1.
